description: This file contains hardware abstraction layer definitions and inline functions for the Nordic nRF5340 radio hardware, including timing constants, power management, and PHY mode configurations.

methods.name: hal_radio_reset
methods.description: Resets the radio hardware to default state.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Stops radio operation and clears high voltage power if used.

methods.name: hal_radio_ram_prio_setup
methods.description: Sets up radio RAM priority (empty implementation).

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Returns the radio PHY mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Returns the closest supported transmit power level at or below the input level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_high_voltage_set
methods.description: Enables high voltage power for +3dBm transmit power.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_high_voltage_clear
methods.description: Disables high voltage power for transmit.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns delay in microseconds for TX ready based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns delay in microseconds for RX ready based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in microseconds for TX based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in microseconds for RX based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns delay in nanoseconds for TX ready based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns delay in nanoseconds for RX ready based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in nanoseconds for TX based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in nanoseconds for RX based on PHY.
